title: Frontline Learning Cards: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: A pump went back into service without a leak test after a seal change.

items.title: Test what you disturb
items.what_happened: The pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test.
items.why_made_sense: There was no return-to-service checklist, so the test was easy to miss [FND-0002].
items.organisation_changing: Work orders now require a recorded leak test before the pump is released.
warning_signs: No test record on the work order
A seal that looks different from the usual part
items.good_looks_like: No restart until the leak-test record is signed.
discussion: Where is the test record kept?
What do you do if the test rig is not available?

items.title: Know what the gas alarm does
items.what_happened: The gas alarm showed on the display but did not shut anything down.
items.why_made_sense: The alarm looked like every other display alert, and nothing told the crew it did not trip equipment [FND-0004].
items.organisation_changing: Alarm labels will say whether the alarm trips equipment or needs a person to act.
warning_signs: An alarm that only shows on a screen
items.good_looks_like: Crews know which alarms trip equipment and which need a person to act.

items.title: Check the part matches the job
items.what_happened: A seal without a specification was fitted to the pump.
items.why_made_sense: The seal came from stores like any other part [FND-0003].
items.organisation_changing: Stores will label critical spares with their specification reference.
warning_signs: No specification reference on the part
Packaging different from the usual supplier
items.good_looks_like: The part's specification is checked before fitting.
discussion: Where do you find the specification?
Who do you ask if it is missing?
What happens to a part you reject?

items.title: Ask for the checklist
items.what_happened: There was no return-to-service checklist for the pump.
items.why_made_sense: Without a checklist, the last steps depended on memory [FND-0002].
items.organisation_changing: A return-to-service checklist is being written with the fitters.
warning_signs: A job you have not done for a while
items.good_looks_like: The checklist is on the work order before the job starts.
discussion: What do you do until it exists?

items.title: Record what you did
items.what_happened: The work order was closed with no test entry.
items.why_made_sense: The work order had no field that asked for a test result [FND-0001].
items.organisation_changing: Work orders will not close without a test result for pressure-boundary work.
warning_signs: A work order with no test field
A test done but not written down
items.good_looks_like: Every test is recorded before the work order closes.
discussion: What if you cannot record it?

items.text: Five minutes on the leak test: why it matters and where the record goes [FND-0001].

items.situation: The test rig is out of service and the pump is needed.
prompts: What do you say to the supervisor?

items.text: Stop and ask if there is no leak-test record before a restart.
Stop and ask if a gas alarm shows and nobody has said what to do.
